summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-10-27 ~ 2026-10-28）

- ⚡ 新增 pci=mmconfig 选项，让全部配置空间优先走 MMCONFIG，降低 x86 传统 CF8/CFC 访问开销（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ virtio balloon 支持回收 EFI unaccepted memory，缩短 SEV 机密虚机内存接纳路径并减少重复扫描（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- 🔧 引入 __must_init 并要求显式提供 kobj_type::release，统一大量 sysfs 属性定义与清理路径（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ dyndbg 重构 classmaps API，统一各子系统查询接口并修正 classmap 行为，影响 printk/DRM/模块加载（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）
- ⚡ iomap/mm 改为按页粒度记脏页，联动 xfs/fuse/gfs2 等 aops，降低大 folio 记账开销（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）
- ⚡ zswap 写回路径引入批量压缩框架并扩展 crypto 异步压缩接口，减少逐页调用开销（[Security](#subsystem-Security)）

## Memory
- `perf` virtio balloon 支持回收 EFI unaccepted memory，缩短 SEV 等机密虚机内存接纳路径并减少重复扫描 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/249)
- `perf` swap 引入按优先级排序的队列，优先换出冷页并降低热页被换出的概率，改善回收效率 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2216)
- 新增 mseal sysmap 启动参数，支持在启动时选择系统映射的密封策略，收紧攻击面 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1323)
- `perf` kfence 支持启动时选择静态键模式，降低生产环境守护开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/428)
- 新增 memcg_ext 接口，可通过 BPF 动态调整 memory.low 与 memory.min，提升内存保护灵活性 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/826)
- slab 硬化特性支持启动时选择，便于按场景权衡安全与性能 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/585)
- `bugfix` 批量修复 mm 多处问题，涵盖 fork、GUP、KSM、CMA、uffd 等路径的映射与引用处理 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/40)
- mglru 在 kswapd 中跳过高阶分配触发的 OOM killing，避免误杀进程 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/209)
- 跨节点迁移时同步迁移 NR_KERNEL_FILE_PAGES 统计，修正节点内存计数偏差 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/346)
- 新 VMA 合并在出错路径更新 VMA 迭代器状态，避免后续遍历使用过期状态 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1226)
- 另有 17 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1779) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2976) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2977) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1278) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1896) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1618) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1802) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2604) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/328) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2106) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/208) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/113) 等 17 项

## Observability
- 将条件分支后的 tracepoint 调用统一改为 trace_call__FOO 形式，覆盖 x86 MSR、GPU、devfreq、UFS 等调用点，未启用时开销更低 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2154)
- `perf` `bugfix` 修复事件过滤器解析与匹配逻辑，并补充 filter 语法检查与 tracing error log 的 selftest 覆盖 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/93)
- `perf` `bugfix` off-cpu 改用 CPU map index 定位 bpf-output 事件，避免硬编码 CPU 编号导致事件错位 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2348)
- `perf` 整理 selftests/bpf 的 GCC 构建流程，移除 clang 专用编译选项，使 bpf-gcc 下测试可正常跑通 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2954)
- `perf` `other` 为 shmem 新增 swapin 结果与分配回退路径的 tracepoint，并补充对应文档 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/908)
- `perf` `other` stat 输出中加入 PMU 名、按 PMU 拆分 uncore 事件，JSON 输出与校验脚本同步更新 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2635)
- `perf` `bugfix` 修复 perf machine 中 thread__resolve_callchain 路径的 NULL 解引用 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1390)
- arena 测试在平台不支持时改为报告 SKIP，而非直接判失败 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2959)
- callx 相关 verifier 测试改为可用 GCC 构建，扩展非 clang 工具链覆盖面 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2953)
- `perf` openrisc KProbes 具体实现：指令解码、单步与 memcpy 等底层支撑 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/17)
- 另有 12 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/319) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2955) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2409) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/15) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2957) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2958) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2960) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2108) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2347) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/274) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/258) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/282)

## Architecture
- `perf` `other` 加入 SPDM 的 Rust 实现，并接入 PCI DOE、TSM core 与 SEV-TIO 认证链路 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/382)
- 引入 __must_init 并要求显式提供 kobj_type::release，统一清理大量 sysfs 属性定义 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2847)
- `perf` 新增 SM8750 CAMSS 支持，补齐 CSID/CSIPHY/VFE 与视频节点 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/302)
- `perf` 新增 pci=mmconfig 选项，优先经 MMCONFIG 访问全部配置空间，减少 x86 传统 CF8/CFC 访问开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/692)
- `perf` 新增 Xiaomi Poco M3（citrus，sm6115）设备树 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/45)
- `perf` x86/entry/32 加固返回用户态路径，收紧入口处的寄存器与栈处理 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/51)
- 新增 Apple M5（t8142）设备树与 dt-bindings，覆盖 J704/J813 平台 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/671)
- imx8dxl-evk 增加 LCDIF 与 101wx001 面板的显示支持 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1992)
- 新增 Mahua QCB 平台 dts 及配套 qcom_scm 改动 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1332)
- glymur 将 PCIe graph 节点下沉到 SoC dtsi，供多款机型复用 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1532)
- 另有 45 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1621) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/583) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1257) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1376) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/265) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1647) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/116) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/336) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/695) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/953) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1089) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1673) 等 45 项

## Core Kernel
- `perf` `bugfix` dyndbg 类映射 API 重构，统一各子系统查询接口并修正 classmap 行为，涉及 printk/DRM/模块加载 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2620)
- kcov 支持采集 init_task 早期启动覆盖率，扩展 x86 与核心子系统构建挂钩 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2316)
- `perf` mm 引入映射冻结机制，允许冻结 file/shmem 映射，减少 khugepaged 与回收路径抖动 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2376)
- `perf` `bugfix` hazptr 修复 torture 测试关机挂起，并增强对睡眠/泄漏的检测 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2271)
- `perf` `bugfix` async 调试计时改用 ktime_us_delta，避免时间差计算溢出导致误报 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1360)
- `bugfix` RCU 增强回调诊断与参数校验，覆盖 tree/tiny/srcu 各实现 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/536)
- `other` group_cpus 对集群掩码做快照，避免分组结果随 CPU 掩码变更而错乱 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/611)
- `bugfix` bootconfig 按文档顺序传递 init 参数，修正参数解析错位 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/613)
- `bugfix` initramfs_test 增加超长 CPIO 名字长度保护的用例覆盖 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/783)

## Drivers
- `perf` `bugfix` ：SDIO 在固定 1.8V vqmmc 下正确完成 UHS 初始化，恢复高速模式 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1515)
- IIO 为全部驱动启用上下文分析，统一锁与上下文校验，降低并发缺陷 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1539)
- 8250 串口将 DMA 取消与缓冲区操作串行化，避免竞态造成数据损坏 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2938)
- 平台驱动可在 PM domain 中跳过上电，交由驱动自行管理电源，避免重复上电 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1803)
- GPIO 增加 PL061 regmap 支持并适配 Ambarella CV75，扩展 gpiolib/regmap 复用 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/326)
- DRM syncobj 引入 eventfd_ctx 作用域清理，简化错误路径释放 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2224)
- `bugfix` ：LED netdev 触发器修复 sysfs_update_group 竞态，避免 UAF [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1253)
- `other` ：MMC core 在系统挂起时保持卡供电，减少恢复后的重新初始化开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1912)
- `other` ：TCSAFLUSH 同时丢弃 flip 缓冲输入，避免刷新后旧输入被读走 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/423)
- `other` ：TCSAFLUSH v2 丢弃 flip 缓冲输入，避免刷新后旧输入被读走 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/714)
- 另有 62 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1174) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2194) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2360) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/505) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/555) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1288) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1658) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1330) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/598) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1924) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1669) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/863) 等 62 项

## Power Management
- qcom-rpmh 稳压器支持 off-on-delay，并把该属性下沉到 regulator 核心与 OF 解析层 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1542)
- 新增 TI LM51772 buck-boost 稳压器驱动，同时在核心与 helper 层补齐所需回调 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/901)
- aat2870 改用 OF 绑定，去掉对板级平台数据的依赖，统一 MFD、稳压器与背光描述 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1247)
- `perf` `other` ：pm_wq 改用 WQ_HIGHPRI 创建工作队列，提升运行时 PM 回调的调度优先级与响应速度 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/808)
- 补充 pm_runtime_use_autosuspend 的撤销语义说明，明确调用配对要求 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1449)
- `bugfix` ：regulator 核心在挂起前冲刷延迟 disable 队列，避免请求关闭的电源在休眠中仍开启 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/462)
- `bugfix` ：regulator 核心在挂起前冲刷延迟 disable 队列，避免请求关闭的电源在休眠中仍开启 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/474)
- `perf` `other` ：intel_pstate 在系统恢复后重新下发 P-state 请求，避免唤醒后频率策略滞后 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1874)
- Intel HFI 驱动在释放内存前停止硬件写入，防止热中断触碰已回收内存 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/84)
- 另有 3 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1704) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1307) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1698)

## Virtualization
- KVM x86 取消 EOI 位图的延迟更新，改为即时生效，去掉 VMX 中多步同步逻辑，降低竞态风险。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2824)
- KVM x86 为别名 xAPIC ID 选择最小 vCPU ID，使中断投递目标确定，不再落到任意匹配 vCPU。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/379)
- `other` KVM x86 把 PIT 存在性检查移入 PIT ioctl 辅助函数，统一入口校验并简化通用 ioctl 路径。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/112)
- `other` KVM x86 故障处理不再复用 guest page fault 的 GPA，避免 MMU 与 SVM 路径沿用陈旧地址。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2542)
- `bugfix` KVM x86 修正 EFER.LMA 与 CR4.PAE 的组合校验，补齐 SVM 嵌套场景并新增 selftest 覆盖。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2858)
- `other` KVM coalesced_mmio 拒绝超出索引范围的 zone 大小，非法 ioctl 参数直接返回错误，防止越界。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/158)
- `bugfix` Hyper-V vmbus 修复动态 ID 竞态，避免设备热插拔时 ID 冲突与引用失效。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/516)
- `other` vboxguest 按设定间隔发送心跳，避免心跳频率异常影响宿主侧存活检测。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2282)

## Filesystem & Storage
- `perf` `other` iomap/mm 改为按页粒度记脏页，联动 xfs/fuse/gfs2 等 aops，减小大 folio 记账开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1245)
- `perf` `bugfix` ceph 修复共享写者的 lazyio 失效，避免重复回写，提升写吞吐 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/529)
- btrfs 新增 provenance time（ptime），经 stat/fileattr/uapi 全链路暴露 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2789)
- overlayfs 只同步经 overlay 写入的数据，btrfs/ext4/xfs 提供配合钩子，减少无关回写 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2724)
- nfsd 新增导出级读写模式选项，可用 netlink 配置以限制客户端读写 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2302)
- pidfd 新增 task path ioctl，可读取目标任务路径，并适配 AppArmor [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/772)
- `bugfix` xfs 校验 btree root numrecs，修复构造镜像触发的越界写 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2032)
- `bugfix` ksmbd 修复 durable reconnect 失败后的 use-after-free [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2020)
- `other` ufs 调整 auto hibern8 的错误检查顺序，避免误判进入低功耗态 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1192)
- `other` ocfs2/dlm 序列化迁移失败的 MLE 清理，避免并发清理破坏链表 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/990)
- 另有 39 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/706) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/356) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/883) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/429) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/280) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/345) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/728) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2495) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2546) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/344) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2043) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1971) 等 39 项

## Security
- `perf` `other` ：在 zswap 写回路径引入批量压缩框架，扩展 crypto 异步压缩接口，减少逐页调用开销、提升压缩吞吐 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/3009)
- `perf` `other` ：key 垃圾回收改为分块处理，缩短单次持锁与扫描时长，降低大 keyring 下的停顿 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/214)
- `perf` `other` ：key 垃圾回收分块处理的初版实现，同样把 gc 工作拆分以减少一次性遍历带来的延迟 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/80)
- `other` ：堵住用户命名空间下绕过 CAP_SETFCAP 设置文件能力的路径，收紧能力边界，并补充自测覆盖 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/1821)

## Scheduling
- `bugfix` sched_ext v7.4 修复集，覆盖子调度器与 cid 路径，修正调度状态处理。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/27/2639)
- 用 Bresenham 算法替代 newidle_balance 的随机选核，使空闲 CPU 拉取任务更均衡。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/317)
